content.short: Polynomial Protocol is a decentralized options liquidity aggregation protocol.
content.description: Polynomial Protocol, founded in 2021, helps users generate passive yield on their assets through automated financial derivative strategies. Its flagship product, Polynomial Earn, runs entirely on-chain by selling options to an automated market maker, a setup the team says is a first for DeFi options vaults (DOVs). The vault charges a 10% performance fee on earned premiums, applied only when the derivative strategies are profitable.
